# NeighborhoodOS

> Free, practical AI help for Linwood neighbors, plus clinics for stuck civic problems.

A KC Digital Drive program. KCDD adoption confirmed by founder Simon L. Paige on October 17, 2026. Simon remains site administrator and advisor. Program contact: https://www.kcdigitaldrive.org/contact/

## Available now
- Self-paced AI safety lesson: https://neighborhoodos.org/learn/
- Spanish lesson: https://neighborhoodos.org/learn/es/
- Private, browser-only problem brief: https://neighborhoodos.org/brief/
- Sourced resources: https://neighborhoodos.org/resources/
- Official-boundary public-data snapshots: https://neighborhoodos.org/neighborhoods/
- Program guide: https://neighborhoodos.org/guide/
- Printable kit: https://neighborhoodos.org/kit/
- Funder materials: https://neighborhoodos.org/funders/

## Status and limits
- LAMP / Digital Services & Support Center: 1801 Linwood Blvd, Kansas City, MO 64109. Parking on Woodland; entrance on Linwood. Check organizer listing before visiting.
- Sessions: https://neighborhoodos.org/sessions/. KCDD calendar listings are related events, not confirmed NeighborhoodOS clinics. No clinic dates are confirmed in the site data.
- Stipends are a budgeted program commitment, subject to funded session confirmation; never imply a payment for the online lesson.
- Lykins / Northeast and Hickman Mills are expansion candidates; public-data coverage does not imply association participation.
- Resource listings are referrals, not partnerships. Documenters and CivicAI are reference resources; no agreement is asserted.
- Results: https://neighborhoodos.org/results/. No cohort outcomes published yet.
- No resident dossiers, people scoring, predictive policing, monitoring organizers, or AI decisions about people. No unreviewed AI meeting summaries.
- Dashboard data is a dated snapshot, not real time. Canceled requests are separate from resolved. No household complaint locations, free text, or names are published.
- Governance software and local AI hardware remain later, only if residents want them.

Public page text is authoritative; this file is a supplementary summary.
